# Round 2: three exploratory edit-transport hypotheses
Frozen 2026-10-02 before tests. This supersedes scout suggestions where they differ. Prior rounds remain developmental. User explicitly requested three ideas and all tested; this is an authorized exploratory pilot, overriding skill preimplementation gate ordering only for pilots. No formal Natural Gate 0 / IPCG / Gate A pass is claimed.

## Scope and boundary
Three distinct observables: (U) held-out action-specific response, (G) geometric rotational identifiability propagated to edit direction, (T) independently fitted temporal path disagreement in edit direction. All choose between identical local/global proper-rotation transports, without training, denoiser calls, new weights or weight changes. These are output-space inference/editing hypotheses, not three native diffusion steering methods. Classical registration/covariance/cycle components are acknowledged prior work. Four previous ActionMesh assets are developmental, not fresh test objects or four backbones.

## Data and split
- Existing kangaroo, octopus, mushroom, panda trajectories; seeds 17,29,41. Each samples 1024 unique material point identities; random order first512 fit/query, next256 utility-only, final256 diagnostic-only. Global fitting uses only first512; local32 nearest other fit IDs. Decision score uses8 nearest utility IDs; report8 other identities. No evaluation support in any rigid fitting. Fixed scale=full first-frame bounding-box diagonal.
- Five equally weighted edit directions: x,y,z and each patch's two dominant PCA axes. Soft upper-z region as prior round, magnitude .03 times scale times weight. Same observed trajectories reused across directions. Three seeds are sampling/noise repeats, not independent objects.
- Analytical controls on first-frame geometry: global noncommuting rotation, two-region noncommuting articulation, each with/without .005 scale coordinate noise except anchor, plus anisotropic stretch model-mismatch control. Known injected transforms define edit-offset GT. All five regimes retained. Natural generated trajectories: diagnostics only, never accuracy GT.
- Optional independent-target task: lexicographic first4 ActionBench UIDs at manifest pinned revision (selected before downloading arrays or outcomes), same point split/seeds. Input trajectory positions plus initial edit along initial provided normal; target offset follows provided future normals at fixed magnitude. Methods never receive future normals. This is an explicitly defined surface-relief editing task on published animated point clouds, not official ActionBench video-to-4D CD metrics. Evaluate clean positions and .005-scale noisy observations, separately; no claim full benchmark or natural generator failure rate. If downloads fail, retain failure, do not replace UIDs.
- Simple task-specific normal baseline: estimate normals from current fit-patch PCA, orient sign toward local transported initial normal. Exposes rotation-only failure under nonrigid deformation; future GT normals forbidden.

## Mechanisms and controls
U uses mean squared mismatch e_t dot d_t versus e_0 dot d_0, local minusglobal. Select local ifscore<0 elseglobal; independent x/y/z averaged response must equal full3D residual/3. Strongbaseline same support full3D held-out residual selector, world/local/global and50:50blend(amplitude loss reported).
G uses J=sum(||r||² I−rrᵀ), practical held-out residual noise, reference-basis covariance eigenvalues capped(pi/2)²; nullmodes assigned cap, notzero pseudoinverse. Score directional uncertainty local minusglobal; compare scalar trace score, direction-shuffled score, fit-residual rank and spatial-split action disagreement. Census weakgeometry minEig(J)/trace(J)<.01; no fabricated occlusion. Planar/line analytic unitcontrols are not prevalence evidence.
T uses independent 0→m→t fits, m={4,8,12}, skip m=t, compare against direct0→t. Score median local action disagreement minusglobal. Compare fullmatrix cycle and same number3 spatialsplit fits (even IDs/first half/mod4<2; overlapping fixed supports, not independent resamples).
For G/T and all ranking controls, fallback top25/50/75% among edited query points separately perframe; primary50%. If scores all numerically tied retainlocal and report realized coverage. Anchor exact. No GT-dependent threshold or coverage selection. Old fixed.005residualgate retained. Pointwise local/global EPE oracle is labeled and used only for regret/headroom.

## Metrics / prospective pilot decisions
Offset EPE/fixedscale primary, all asset/seed/regime/direction cells retained. First macro within asset then over4 assets; no point/frame significance or population CI. Also oracle regret, fallback fraction, amplitude error, switching rate, speed/edge diagnostics only. No self-objective reduction labeled quality.
U survives development only if >=10% mixed articulation/noisy EPE gain vs fullheldoutselector, positive in>=3/4assets, beats best aggregate fixedlocal/global, no>10% global-noisy regression. G survives only if>=10% gain vs best scalar ranking at50%, >=3/4assets positive, no>5% clean articulation regression, >=3assets have weak-support stratum, and spatial alternative does not matchwithin5%. T survives only if>=5% gain vs residualrank and matrixcycle50%,>=3/4assets positive,no>5% globalnoisy regression, and spatial alternative notwithin1%. Report stricter strongestalternative failures. If oracle headroom<5%, mark selection test uninformative. Future-normal task is independent evidence; count four objects honestly and compare per-framePCA baseline. Mixed/negative results stay visible. No current outcome establishes novelty, cross-model performance, model hallucination repair or ICML readiness.

## Resources / records
One sequential CUDA process, max600s diagnostic runtime (excluding file download/transfer); no training/model calls, max22GiB GPU, input+output budget<500MB new remote disk. Record actual torch peak plus sampled nvidia-smi, elapsed, all seeds, source hashes, dataset revision and SHA256, exceptions/exitstatus. Do not silently switchCPU, reduce samples, change scores or tune after results. Result-affecting fixes require child protocol note. Save code/results to results/round2-ideas-20261002, mirror to user /Users/yunbo/Documents/4d after validation. No GitHub push in this scope.

## Pre-run transfer amendment (no results yet)
2026-10-02: direct Chinese HF mirror timed out. Downloaded same pinned4UIDs on localmachine (154MB), SHA256recorded. Full SCP transfer was stopped after reachingonly3.3MB in severalminutes. Transfer lossless NPZ of exactly the predeclared1024points perseed17/29/41, preserving original pointIDs, float32values and full100000-point first-frame scale. No method, samples or evaluation changes; full originals remain local. The child runner loads cached ordered points without resampling. All output includes source and subset hashes. Normal clean/noisy arrays remain separate. Temporal actual fit pairs42 vs45 spatial at16frames (exclude selfedges), approximate notexact matchedcompute. Geometry shuffle preserves each original nonzero norm andsupport; uniformworld-axis edits naturally unchanged byshuffle.
